verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents a first-party natural-language interface. Users can get recent logs or charts "by simply asking in natural language," call an AI SRE agent by tagging @betterstack in Slack, and chat with it online, in MS Teams, or in Claude Code via its MCP server. The evidence covers natural-language querying and investigation, but not natural-language operation of the product itself (creating monitors, changing schedules, resolving incidents), and the AI SRE only suggests hypotheses rather than acting without approval. Missing for 10: documented natural-language control of configuration and actions beyond querying and investigation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Get recent logs or chart visualizations by simply asking in natural language.
